items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: I sure remember the secretary, Rocky Albertini. ... Go down and see Rocky Albertini in the back of his shoe store, and he signed me up

ctx.x: Yeah well I think I was already starting to play. Yeah, at 15 you know I was starting to play. I joined the Musicians Union I guess that’s what I’m trying to say. Even up in Thunder Bay, Ontario, which at that time it was two towns in Northern Ontario, Fort William, Fort Arthur, me being from Fort William they amalgamated in 1967 and became Thunder Bay. But in Fort William we had a branch of the Local AF of M up there. I can’t remember the number of the Local now, I should be ashamed of myself. But I sure…

in what we call middle school here now, up there it was junior high (grades 7 or 8) I just made a decision, you know instead of playing a little piece by Mozart this time I’m going to play “Pipeline” by the Chantays. [scats] I had learned how to do all that on the piano.
